title: Finite models of pointed etale neighbourhoods over integral morphisms
statement: Let f:X\to Y be integral [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], Omega algebraically closed, y:Spec Omega\to Y, t:Spec Omega\to X with t followed by f equal to y, and (V,v) a pointed etale neighbourhood of t [def-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-neighbourhoods]. There exist a pointed etale neighbourhood c of y, a scheme Z finite over c, and a map rho:c times_Y X\to Z over c. There is an etale Z-scheme W and a map a:W times_Z (c times_Y X)\to V over X, with a geometric point r mapping to v under a and to (c.point,t) under the second projection. Fibre products are as in [def-pc-fibre-product].

source.place: Proof, integral algebra over the strict henselisation and conservativity

proof.text: Choose an affine pointed etale base neighbourhood c; its pullback T is affine since f is integral. Pull V back to T, and choose a standard etale affine chart at (v,(u,t)). Lift the geometric point through this chart using the separably closed lifting theorem.

Descend the single standard etale pair over Gamma(T) to a finite subalgebra over Gamma(c) using the coefficient descent theorem. Take Z to be its spectrum, W the descended standard etale scheme and rho the induced spectrum map.
Use pullbackSpecIso and the algebra equivalence to construct the map a and point r. Check the two pullback projections and the map to V by pullback hom-ext and Spec functoriality.

proof_origin.place: Finite approximation of the integral algebra; geometric standard-etale chart, coefficient descent, and explicit tensor-product and marked-point equations.

lean.statement: theorem exists_pointed_etale_finite_model {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegralHom f] {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (y : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y) (t : Scheme.Hom.GeometricFiber f y) (V : X.Etale) (v : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale t.1).fiber.obj V) : ∃ (c : Scheme.Hom.Nbhd y) (Z : Scheme.{u}) (g : Z ⟶ c.1.left), IsFinite g ∧ ∃ (ρ : pullback c.1.hom f ⟶ Z), ρ ≫ g = pullback.fst c.1.hom f ∧ ∃ (W : Z.Etale) (r : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ pullback W.hom ρ) (a : pullback W.hom ρ ⟶ V.left), a ≫ V.hom = pullback.snd W.hom ρ ≫ pullback.snd c.1.hom f ∧ r ≫ a = v.left ∧ r ≫ pullback.snd W.hom ρ = basePt f c t
